AI IN MY DESIGN PRACTICE

AI-accelerated. Human-led.

I use AI to explore directions, organise research notes and turn ideas into working prototypes. I still check the sources, question the output and make the design decisions.

Explore my AI practice

01 / EXPLORE

More room to try.

I use AI for early design exploration and functional prototypes, so I can spend more time reviewing the experience.

02 / CHECK

Keep the evidence close.

I verify summaries against their sources, retain conflicting findings and keep assumptions separate from research evidence.

03 / DESIGN

Make AI easier to use.

My work on Kremor AI and Chalant AI explores prompting, output review, confirmation and control.
